findings.message: Tool input is interpolated into a command interpreted by a shell.
findings.remediation: Replace shell execution with a fixed executable and an argument array. Validate each argument against an allowlist and keep shell mode disabled.
findings.title: MCP input reaches shell execution

findings.message: A credential-like value is assigned directly instead of being loaded from a secret binding.
findings.remediation: Revoke the exposed credential, remove it from history, and load the replacement from a narrowly scoped secret store at runtime.
findings.title: Hardcoded credential

findings.message: Tool input is used as a filesystem path without a visible canonical-root check.
findings.remediation: Resolve the requested path beneath a fixed root, compare the canonical path to that root, and reject absolute paths and parent traversal.
findings.title: MCP input reaches a filesystem path
